name: Eden
overview: Scripture reveals Eden as the divinely planted garden where God placed the first man, filled with every tree pleasant to the sight and good for food, including the tree of life and the tree of knowledge of good and evil. A river flowed out from Eden to water the garden and divided into four branches, encompassing regions rich in valuable resources such as gold, bdellium, and onyx. This setting underscores God's provision and the original harmony of creation before the fall.
